shared_elements: low-relief bodies with incised linear detail for drapery
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: several human figures rendered in modelled low relief with incised parallel lines for pleated garments and distinctive headdresses. Otherwise the content differs sharply: A is a horizontal procession of profile attendants leading a two-humped camel between rosette borders, while B is a circular openwork composition of frontal seated/flanking figures with no animal, no linear frieze and no rosette band.
